message: What items do I need to hold for my objectives?

!startConversation("Jill_0", "Your objectives are to hold paper, a golden apple, sugar, and bone meal. You need 3 sugar cane for paper, 1 for sugar, 1 apple and 8 gold ingots for the golden apple, and 1 bone for bone meal.")

!startConversation("Andy_0", "I need paper, sugar, a golden apple, and bone meal. I already have an apple and 5 gold ingots; please keep an eye out for 3 sugar cane, 3 gold ingots, and a bone.")
I need paper, sugar, a golden apple, and bone meal. I already have an apple and 5 gold ingots; please keep an eye out for 3 sugar cane, 3 gold ingots, and a bone.
!givePlayer("Jill_0", "gold_ingot", 3)
!searchForBlock("sugar_cane", 128)
!searchForBlock("chest", 128)
I've got my targets: paper, sugar, golden apple, and bone meal. All acquired and keeping them.
!goToPlayer("Jill_0", 3)
I gave you the sugar cane earlier; did you get it? Also, what are my objective items?
!startConversation("Andy_0", "Yes, I got it—it's now sugar and paper. Your objectives are stone_bricks, polished_andesite, granite_slab, and smooth_stone_slab.")

!getCraftingPlan("stone_bricks", 1)
